purpose: City-specific registry/map source review and bounded safe route inspection for the WUP ranked settlement point (Bikaner).
primaryPublisher: Rajasthan Department of Urban Development and Housing; Bikaner Municipal Corporation
registryBasis: The Rajasthan Urban GIS portal advertises Khasra/plot layers and a City/ULB selector, and Bikaner Municipal Corporation publishes ward-boundary material and city property/plot statistics. The available evidence does not establish that a Bikaner-bound cadastral registry or parcel-vector route is exposed, so registry presence is left undetermined.

officialSources.observation: Official Rajasthan Urban GIS presents Khasra and plot layers plus district/city-ULB selectors. Its disclaimer states Khasra/village boundaries are for viewing only and not for legal use. No Khasra or plot identifier was selected or queried.
Official Bikaner Municipal Corporation portal publishes city material including ward-boundary references; no cadastral vector schema found.
Official Rajasthan local-government portal lists Bikaner among urban local bodies; this does not prove parcel-service coverage.

searchQueries.scope: Find city-specific primary registry evidence and a safe anonymous geometry-only route.
searchQueries.result: The Rajasthan Urban GIS portal advertises Khasra/plot layers and a City/ULB selector, and Bikaner Municipal Corporation publishes ward-boundary material and city property/plot statistics. The available evidence does not establish that a Bikaner-bound cadastral registry or parcel-vector route is exposed, so registry presence is left undetermined. The public Rajasthan Urban GIS page lists Khasra, plot, urban-jurisdiction, and other layers but places Khasra and plot lookup behind selectors; no selector was submitted. Its disclaimer says the Khasra/village data is for viewing only and not legal use. The municipal site publishes ward-boundary material, not a parcel feature schema. Direct standard HTTPS shell access timed out without an HTTP status; the public page was inspected via web rendering.
